observed_pre_fix_defects.cause: The byte lexer did not establish identifier boundaries for C universal character names; removing braces could merge else with an escaped identifier while still producing valid C
observed_pre_fix_defects.general_fix: Only apply structural splices where the lexer establishes supported C token and ASCII identifier boundaries; retain identity with an explicit reason for other identifier spellings, while allowing escapes inside quoted tokens

observed_pre_fix_defects.cause: Pragma operators and macro invocations can affect preprocessing state without leaving a statement AST; replacing their enclosing source range could remove their effects on later declarations
observed_pre_fix_defects.general_fix: Protect lexical macro occurrences, pragma operators and directives in function bodies in addition to AST expansion locations; enforce the identifier spelling contract when macro-name correspondence is not established

additional_contract_fix: Protect indirect calls because the local AST does not establish the target's returns-twice or context-observation attributes; this was a missing contract fact, not a demonstrated runtime miscompilation
